status_summary: No enacted law and no FCC action on this item was found. In the House, the Energy and Commerce Committee reported the App Store Accountability Act (H.R. 3149, which targets age-restricted material through app stores) and the KIDS Act (H.R. 7757, an omnibus that includes age-based safeguards for minors) on 2026-03-05, and the House passed the KIDS Act 267 to 117 on 2026-06-29; it was referred to Senate Commerce on 2026-07-13. The Senate Commerce Committee ordered the Kids Online Safety Act (S. 1748) reported on 2026-08-05, and the Senate companion to the app store bill (S. 1586) has had no action since referral on 2025-05-01; neither chamber has passed the other's bill. A search of the Federal Register found no FCC document since 2025-01-20 on age verification or social media for minors, and the FTC, not the FCC, issued a COPPA policy statement on age-verification data on 2026-02-25.

timeline.event: House Energy and Commerce Committee reported the App Store Accountability Act (H.R. 3149) by 26 to 23 and the KIDS Act (H.R. 7757) by 28 to 24, both as amended.
The House passed the KIDS Act (H.R. 7757), 267 to 117 under suspension of the rules (roll call 228); it was received in the Senate and referred to Commerce on 2026-07-13.
The Senate Commerce Committee ordered the Kids Online Safety Act (S. 1748) reported favorably with an amendment in the nature of a substitute.

title: Strengthen protections against young children using social media despite age limits
uncertainties: Congress.gov pages could not be opened; bill actions come from GovInfo bill status data read through a summarizing fetch tool. That data shows H.R. 3149 only through its 2025-12-11 subcommittee step and lists no committee report for H.R. 7757 (introduced 2026-03-03), so the 2026-03-05 full-committee votes for both rest on the committee recap. Whether H.R. 3149 was folded into the House-passed KIDS Act was not established. The 2026-09-30 Senate objection comes from one trade news article. The TAKE IT DOWN Act concerns non-consensual intimate images, not age access, and is context only. The Federal Register search covered two phrases (age verification, Section 230) and the FCC's own pages were not searched, so a non-Federal Register FCC step cannot be fully excluded. The Mandate names no mechanism, so the match to the age-gating bills is a judgment. The GovInfo record for H.R. 7757 lists several short titles inside the omnibus but not the App Store Accountability Act. Rechecked 2026-10-26: GovInfo bill status for S. 1748 (latest action 2026-08-05) and H.R. 7757 (latest action 2026-07-13) shows no later action, and a news search found no Senate floor vote or FCC age-access action after 2026-10-06.
